5.5.1 Std_ReturnType
The specification in [31] specifies a standard API return type Std_ReturnType. The Std_ReturnType defines the "‘status"’ and "‘error values"’ returned by API functions. It is defined as a uint8 type. The value “0” is reserved for “No error occurred”. 0 1 2 3 4 5 6
